TaxStreem Website Copy v3 · What changed from v2This version applies your twelve notes and the answers you wrote into v2. Square brackets mark buttons. Lines starting "Screen:" brief the build and are not page text.Your noteWhat v3 does1. InventoryCountev now has a full inventory section: units, branches, counts, stock loss, reorder, pricing, expiry. Inventory also appears on Home, Platforms, Pricing and the modules page.2. Integration logosThe Integrations page is a logo grid. Personal Income Tax integrations (Grey, Selar, Nestuge, Upwork, Countev) are listed as coming soon. I need the logo files.3. Referral programmeNew Partners page with the referral programme. It is also on the Tax Professionals and Pricing pages.4. Links[Get Started] in the header and every [Sign Up] button open www.taxstreem.com/get-invite. Log in opens app.taxstreem.com.5. No demo bookingEvery [Book a demo] is gone, and so is the demo page. The second button is [Talk to us], which opens Contact.6 and 7. ResourcesThe Resources menu and page stay, fed by your existing articles.8. CompanyCompany is in the header with About Us, Newsroom, Careers, Partners and Contact Us.9. HeaderThe header is the one on the site today: Products, Solutions, Developers, Security, Resources, Company, Pricing. "What you get" now sits inside Solutions.10. DevelopersEvery developer link opens developer-portal.taxstreem.com. There is no developer page on the new site.11. MartinaMartina has her own page and a section on Home: she acts, calls, works on WhatsApp, explains numbers and brings insights.12. Tax ProfessionalsRewritten from the accountant portal as built: practice roles, client invitations, requests, deadlines, changed returns, licence checks.
Your answers, applied: refunds softened to "tracks what you are owed"; payroll left out; Personal Income Tax add-on at ₦10,000 a month; Tax Professionals use the portal free; 15% off annual payment; only Lagos named for PIT; "State Internal Revenue Service" added to the hero.One edit of yours I reworded. You wrote that the inventory system is "the first ever AI-powered inventory management system". Your own rule 2 bars superlatives, and a "first ever" claim invites a challenge. The line now says what the agents do.Still needed from youLogos, as SVG or as PNG on a transparent background: Mono, Paystack, Flutterwave, Moniepoint, Bujeti, QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books, NRS, LIRS, CAC, WhatsApp, Grey, Selar, Nestuge and Upwork. Also the TaxStreem and Countev logos, the five module logos (Numens, Prism, Atlas, Flux, Martina), the press logos and the NVIDIA Inception and Google for Startups badges.Founders. A photo and a short profile each for Kelechi Ibe and Ayo Samuel, for the About Us page.From your CTO, for the Resources page. The name of the CMS your articles live in, and read-only access to it set up in the hosting settings. Keys never go in chat.Pricing table. Martina's calls sit in Growth and Enterprise. Say if calls are priced another way.NBA licences. The copy now lists NBA beside ICAN, ANAN and CITN. The portal checks the first three today, so NBA checking has to be added to the app before the site goes live.Second round of changes, 10 NovemberYour noteWhat changed1. Button labelsThe header button reads [Get Started]. Every other sign-up button reads [Sign Up]. Both open www.taxstreem.com/get-invite.2. Partner bonusThe Partners page carries the programme as built in Countev: the rates on the portal's Earnings page, 10% as Bronze and 15% as Silver, with bonuses of ₦25,000, ₦75,000 and ₦200,000.3 and 6. Logos, photos, module logosRequested above. The modules page and About Us page have places for them.4. Privacy and termsThe footer links to www.taxstreem.com/privacy and www.taxstreem.com/terms. Their text stays as published.5. Resources and developer portalBuild notes added under the Resources and Developers menus.7. Martina phones customersAdded on the home page, the Martina page and the modules page.8. Tax professionalsClearer opening, and a new table of the reports produced for every client.9. Martina on the home pageRewritten around margins, losses, money owed to you and customer reminders.10. NBAAdded wherever licences are named.

Lagos, Nigeria and Delaware, USA. · NDPA and GDPR compliant · ISO 27001:2022 in progress · NVIDIA Inception · Google for StartupsSocial: LinkedIn, X, YouTube, InstagramHomeThe home page makes one promise, shows the six results, then sends each visitor to their product.1. HeroKicker: Tax and bookkeeping for African businesses. Live in Nigeria.Tax Compliance Finally on AutopilotTaxStreem keeps your books from your bank, sales and supplier invoices. Then it prepares and files your VAT, WHT, CIT and PIT returns with the Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) and your State Internal Revenue Service. You check and approve.[Sign Up] [See the products]Line under the buttons: Set up in a day. Cancel any time.Screen: a looping product film. A supplier invoice arrives, its VAT is picked out, the stock on it goes into a branch, the bank payment matches it, the VAT return for the month updates, and the return shows "Filed with NRS".2. Recognition stripAs covered in TechCabal, BusinessDay, Nairametrics, The Guardian and TechNext. Supported by NVIDIA Inception and Google for Startups.3. What you getKicker: What changesSix results you can check at month-end.ResultCopyRecover your input VATMost businesses pay VAT to suppliers and never claim it back. TaxStreem reads each supplier invoice, records the VAT, and sets it against the VAT you charge once the invoice is paid.Know what you are owedCustomers deduct Withholding Tax (WHT) when they pay you. TaxStreem records every deduction and its credit note, and tracks excess VAT, so you always know what you are owed.Books that get you fundedBanks and investors ask for financial statements. Yours are prepared to IFRS from live data: profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow, any day you need them.Every return filed on timeVAT and WHT monthly. Companies Income Tax (CIT) and Personal Income Tax (PIT) yearly. TaxStreem prepares each return from your books and files it on the tax portal, including portals with no API.Hours back for your finance teamSupplier bills are read and checked. Payments are matched. Stock is received from the invoice. Month-end close becomes a review.One set of numbersBank, POS, wallet, stock and ledger are reconciled against each other every day. When something does not match, you see it that day.
Screen: each result opens a small animated screen beside it (the VAT card shows an invoice's VAT moving into the return; the reconciliation card shows three columns ticking off).4. Choose your productKicker: Four products, one loginStart with the one built for how you work.ProductWho it is forWhat it doesButtonTaxStreem for Service BusinessesFirms, agencies, consultancies, schools, clinics, tech companiesInvoicing, supplier bills, payments, books, VAT, WHT and CIT[See Service Businesses]CountevRetail, restaurants, pharmacies, manufacturing, distribution, any business with stock or walk-in customersEverything above, plus inventory run by AI agents, a till, POS terminals and branches[See Countev]TaxStreem for Personal Income TaxFreelancers, creators, contractors, professionalsWorks out your tax and files your annual return with your state tax authority[See Personal Income Tax]TaxStreem for Tax ProfessionalsAccountants, lawyers, finance professionals, tax consultantsA free portal for every client's books, returns and documents, and a share of what your clients pay[See Tax Professionals]
5. How it worksKicker: Three stepsFrom bank alert to filed return.Connect. Link your bank accounts, payment provider and POS, or upload statements. Import from QuickBooks, Xero or Zoho Books if you use them.Review. TaxStreem records each transaction, reads each invoice and asks you only about the ones it is unsure of.File. Your returns are prepared from the books. Approve them and TaxStreem files with the NRS or your state tax authority, then keeps the receipt.6. See the productKicker: Try it hereClick through a month in TaxStreem.Screen: an interactive product with five tabs. Each tab is a working screen with sample data.TabWhat the visitor can doCaptionMoney inCreate an invoice and watch VAT and the e-invoice reference appearInvoices that carry the right VAT and reach the NRS.Money outOpen a supplier bill that was read from a photo; approve itBills checked for errors before you pay.InventoryReceive goods from that bill into a branch; see the items most at risk of lossStock goes up when the invoice is approved. Countev tells you what to count next.BooksAnswer one bank transaction question; see the profit and loss updateYou answer the doubtful ones. The rest is recorded for you.TaxOpen the VAT return for the month and press FileOutput VAT, input VAT, what you owe. Filed from here.
7. InventoryKicker: CountevInventory that watches itself.AI agents track what you hold in every branch, what it is worth, what is selling and what is going missing. Each morning they pick the items most likely to have lost money and ask someone to count them.[See Countev]Screen: the stock loss screen. "Leaking ₦184,000 a month" at the top, a list headed "Count these next" with a reason beside each item, and one item being counted on a phone.8. MartinaKicker: Meet MartinaMartina watches your numbers and tells you first.Martina is the AI agent inside TaxStreem. She works on WhatsApp and by phone, in English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa or Igbo. She tells you when the margin on a product starts to shrink and shows you where money or stock is leaking. She keeps the list of customers who owe you, with how long each has owed, then reminds them and phones the ones who stay silent. Ask her anything about your books and she answers from your own figures. Your VAT return still goes in on time.[Meet Martina]Screen: a WhatsApp chat. Martina writes first: "Your margin on 50kg rice fell from 18% to 11% this month. Your supplier raised the price twice and your selling price stayed the same." The owner replies with a voice note, "Who owes me the most?" Martina lists three customers with the amount and days overdue, then asks, "Shall I remind them today and call anyone who has not paid by Friday?" The owner types "Yes".9. E-invoicingKicker: E-invoicingReady for NRS e-invoicing before it reaches you.Nigeria is moving every business to electronic invoices validated by the NRS. TaxStreem sends each invoice to the NRS, returns it with its Invoice Reference Number and QR code, and delivers it to your customer. TaxStreem's accreditation as a System Integrator and Access Point Provider is in progress.[See how e-invoicing works]10. Embedded infrastructureKicker: For fintechs, banks and business platformsOffer tax to your customers without building it.Tax computation, e-invoicing, inventory management, bookkeeping and filing are available through one API. Your customers stay in your product. TaxStreem does the tax work behind it.[See embedded infrastructure] [Read the API docs]Screen: the request and response demo. Tabs: Compute VAT, Send an e-invoice, File a return.11. Integrations stripLine: Connected to the banks, payment providers and tax portals you already use. Logo row. [See all integrations]12. SecurityKicker: SecurityYour financial data is handled with care.Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. E-invoicing keys are held in a hardware security module. Access is by role, with two-step sign-in for owners. TaxStreem complies with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA) and GDPR. ISO 27001:2022 certification is in progress.[Visit the Trust Centre]13. QuestionsCommon questionsWhat is TaxStreem? TaxStreem is tax and bookkeeping software for businesses and individuals in Nigeria. It keeps your books, issues your invoices, manages your inventory, and prepares and files your VAT, WHT, CIT and PIT returns.Which taxes does TaxStreem file? Value Added Tax (VAT), Withholding Tax (WHT), Companies Income Tax (CIT) and Personal Income Tax (PIT). VAT, WHT and CIT are filed with the Nigeria Revenue Service. PIT is filed with the Lagos State Internal Revenue Service (LIRS).How does TaxStreem help me recover input VAT? It reads the VAT on each supplier invoice, checks the supplier's Tax ID, and claims the VAT in the month the invoice is paid. The VAT return shows every invoice behind the figure.Can TaxStreem file where the tax portal has no API? Yes. TaxStreem's filing agent completes the return on the portal, submits it and saves the acknowledgement.Do I need an accountant to use it? No. If you have one, invite them. They work on your books from their own portal, at no cost to them.Is TaxStreem only for Nigeria? TaxStreem is built for African businesses and is live in Nigeria today. More countries will follow.How much does it cost? Starter is ₦30,000 a month and Growth is ₦75,000 a month, with 15% off when you pay for a year. Personal Income Tax is ₦50,000 a year. Enterprise pricing is agreed with you.14. ClosingMonth-end is coming. Have it done.Set up takes a day. Your first reconciled month takes about a week.[Sign Up] [Talk to us]Product pagesAll four pages share one layout: hero, what it does, a product screen per section, who uses it, questions, closing buttons.TaxStreem for Service BusinessesKicker: For firms, agencies, consultancies, schools, clinics and tech companiesSend the invoice. Pay the bill. The books and the tax are already done.TaxStreem for Service Businesses runs invoicing, supplier bills, payments, bookkeeping and tax for businesses that sell their time and expertise.[Sign Up] [See pricing]Screen: an invoice being written with a service line, VAT added, WHT expected from the customer shown underneath, then marked "Paid, short by WHT, settled".SectionHeadingCopyGet paidInvoices that know the tax.Each invoice carries the right VAT treatment for what you sell and goes to the NRS as an e-invoice. When a customer pays less because they deducted WHT, TaxStreem recognises the deduction, settles the invoice and records your credit.Pay suppliersBills checked before money leaves.Suppliers upload invoices to your own portal link, or you forward them. TaxStreem reads each one, checks the Tax ID, the bank account name and the arithmetic, and tells the supplier what to fix by WhatsApp or email. Pay one or pay in bulk, with WHT deducted where the law requires it.BooksBookkeeping that waits for your review.Bank and wallet transactions are recorded as they arrive. For anything unclear, TaxStreem offers its best guess and a short list to pick from. Financial statements follow IFRS.VATInput VAT claimed. Output VAT reported.The monthly VAT return is built from your invoices and bills, with every figure traceable to a document.WHTWithholding Tax in both directions.What you deducted from suppliers is scheduled for remittance. What customers deducted from you is tracked as credit.CITCompanies Income Tax from your own books.The year-end computation, capital allowances and the NRS return are prepared from the ledger. Business names and partnerships get Personal Income Tax returns for each owner.Month-endClose the month in an afternoon.A checklist shows what is unreconciled, unposted or unanswered. Clear it and the period locks.DocumentsEvery paper in its place.Invoices, receipts, returns and tax receipts are filed by month and downloadable for an audit or a loan application.
Who uses it: law firms, consulting firms, agencies, software companies, schools, clinics, logistics and facility managers.QuestionsDoes it handle WHT that my customers deduct? Yes. A payment short by the expected WHT settles the invoice, and the deduction is recorded as a WHT credit.We are a business name, not a company. Does it still work? Yes. TaxStreem checks your registration type and prepares Personal Income Tax returns for the owners in place of CIT.Can my accountant use it with me? Yes. Invite them from Settings. They work from their own portal, free, and you get 20% off your first payment.Closing: Bill your next client from TaxStreem. [Sign Up] [Talk to us]CountevKicker: Countev by TaxStreem. For retail, restaurants, pharmacies, manufacturing and distribution.Stock, sales, books and tax. Counted once.Countev is an inventory, sales and accounting system run by AI agents. Every sale reduces stock, lands in the books and shows in your VAT return. Every supplier invoice puts stock in.[Sign Up] [See pricing]Screen: the till. A cashier adds three items, sends ₦18,400 to a POS terminal, the payment is confirmed, stock for each item drops, and the day's sales total rises.InventoryKnow what you have, what it is worth and where it is going.SectionHeadingCopyItemsSet up your items in minutes.Upload any spreadsheet and Countev matches its columns. Or photograph a product and it reads the name, size and barcode. Raw materials, packaging, goods for resale and finished goods are kept apart.UnitsBuy in cartons. Sell in pieces.Each item knows its purchase unit and its selling unit, so a carton of 24 becomes 24 tins without anyone doing the sum.BranchesEvery branch and store, one view.Stock is held by location. Transfers leave one branch and wait to be received at the other.ReceivingStock goes in from the supplier's invoice.Upload the invoice or take a photo. Countev matches each line to your items, suggests new products, and puts the stock into the branch you choose once you approve. Lower the quantity if less arrived.ValueStock value you can put on a balance sheet.Cost is averaged across every purchase, so the value of what you hold and the cost of what you sold are always current.Stock lossFind out what is going missing, this week.Countev adds up shortages, damage and expiry, shows the monthly loss by branch, and lists the items most likely to have lost money since anyone last checked.CountsA short count every morning.Each day Countev picks a few high-risk items per branch and assigns them to someone who did not sell them. Counts are done on a phone and approved by a manager.ReorderOrder before the shelf is empty.Reorder suggestions come from how fast each item sells. Approve the purchase order and Martina can phone the vendor to confirm it.PricingPrices that follow your costs.When a supplier's price rises, Countev proposes a new selling price that protects your margin. You decide.ExpiryBatches and expiry dates tracked.Know what expires this month and sell it first.
Selling, books and taxSectionHeadingCopySellA till that works on a phone or a computer.Sell by cash, bank transfer, payment link or card. Send the amount to a Moniepoint POS terminal from the till and Countev confirms the payment for you.ReconcilePayments, books and stock agree.POS settlements, bank lines and wallet payouts are matched to sales. Cash short at close of day is shown against the cashier's takings.BooksAccounts kept while you trade.Sales, purchases, stock movements and expenses post to the ledger. Profit by item, by branch and by month.TaxVAT, WHT, CIT and PIT from the same data.Each item carries its VAT treatment: standard, zero-rated or exempt. Returns are prepared from actual sales and purchases.StaffGive each person only what they need.Cashiers sell. Store keepers receive stock. Managers approve counts. Owners see everything.
Who uses it: supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants, boutiques, building materials dealers, FMCG distributors, bakeries and small manufacturers.QuestionsDo I need to buy hardware? No. Countev runs in a browser and on a phone. Connect a Moniepoint terminal if you take cards.Can it handle more than one branch? Yes. Stock, sales and staff are kept by branch, with transfers between them.How does Countev find stock losses? It compares every count, write-off and cash-up with what the books expect, values the difference, and tells you which items and branches to check first.Which items are VAT-exempt or zero-rated? Countev decides for each item under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 and asks you to confirm any it is unsure about.Can I talk to it? Yes. Send Martina a voice note such as "sold three cartons of noodles, transfer" and the sale is recorded. She understands Nigerian English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo.Closing: Count your stock one last time. Then let Countev keep it. [Sign Up] [Talk to us]TaxStreem for Personal Income TaxKicker: For freelancers, creators, contractors and professionalsFile your personal income tax in one sitting.Answer a few questions, connect your bank or upload a statement, and TaxStreem works out your Personal Income Tax (PIT) under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025. Then it files your annual return with the Lagos State Internal Revenue Service (LIRS).[Sign Up] · ₦50,000 a yearScreen: a short walk-through on a phone. Income is totalled, rent relief and pension are deducted, tax payable appears, then "Filed with LIRS" and a payment account number with a countdown.SectionHeadingCopyIncomeAll your income in one figure.Client payments, platform payouts, salary and rent are pulled from your statements and grouped for you.ReliefsClaim what the law allows.Rent relief, pension, health insurance and life assurance are applied when you add the document for each.FilingFiled in your name, on LIRS e-Tax.TaxStreem files your return for Lagos and raises your assessment.PaymentPay the exact amount, to the state's own account.You get the state's payment details inside TaxStreem. Your receipt is saved when the payment is confirmed.TCCYour Tax Clearance Certificate, kept.Once issued, your TCC is stored with your return for visa, loan and contract applications.Add-onRun your work from here too. ₦10,000 a month.Tax-compliant invoices with payment reminders, bookkeeping, payment collection, and insights into what you earn and spend.Coming soonIncome pulled from where you earn.Connections to Grey, Selar, Nestuge, Upwork and Countev are on the way.
QuestionsWhen is the personal income tax return due? By 31 March each year, for income earned in the previous year.I earn below ₦800,000 a year. Do I still file? Yes. The first ₦800,000 is taxed at 0%, and you still file a return.I have a salary and a side business. Can I file both? Yes. TaxStreem combines your employment income, with the PAYE your employer already paid, and your other income in one return.I do not live in Lagos. Can I use it? Filing is live for Lagos today. Other states will be announced here.Do you see my portal password? You enter your own e-Tax login. It is encrypted, used only to file your return, and you can remove it at any time.Closing: 31 March comes every year. Be done in January. Free.Run every client from one login, at no cost. TaxStreem keeps each client's books from their bank, sales and supplier invoices, then prepares their VAT, WHT, CIT and PIT returns. You receive the ledgers, schedules and working papers behind every figure, ready to review, correct in Excel and sign off. Twelve clients sorted by urgency: "VAT due in 3 days", "2 answers from client", "14 bank lines to match". One click opens a client's books.SectionHeadingCopyPracticeSet up your firm, or work alone.A practice has partners, managers and staff. Partners and managers see every client. Images carry alt text that describes what the screen shows.Glossary (page at /resources/glossary, also used for tooltips)TermPlain meaningValue Added Tax (VAT)A 7.5% tax added to the price of most goods and services in Nigeria. A business collects it from customers and pays it over, less the VAT it paid on its own purchases.Output VATThe VAT you charge your customers.Input VATThe VAT your suppliers charge you. You can set it against your output VAT when the invoice meets the rules.Withholding Tax (WHT)An advance payment of income tax. The payer deducts it from what it owes a supplier and pays it to the tax authority.WHT credit noteProof that tax was withheld from you. It reduces your income tax bill.Company Income Tax (CIT)The tax a company pays on its profit for the year.Personal Income Tax (PIT)The tax an individual pays on income, including salary, business and freelance income.Pay As You Earn (PAYE)PIT that an employer deducts from salaries each month.Tax Identification Number (TIN)The number that identifies a taxpayer to the tax authorities.Tax Clearance Certificate (TCC)A certificate showing your taxes are paid for the last three years.Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS)The federal tax authority, formerly the Federal Inland Revenue Service (FIRS).State Internal Revenue Service (SIRS)The tax authority of a state. It collects PIT from residents. LIRS is the one for Lagos.E-invoicingSending each invoice to the NRS platform in a set format for validation.System Integrator (SI)A company accredited to connect a business's software to the NRS e-invoicing platform.Access Point Provider (APP)A company accredited to transmit e-invoices to the NRS platform on behalf of businesses.ReconciliationChecking that two records of the same money or stock agree, and explaining any difference.IFRSInternational Financial Reporting Standards, the accounting rules Nigerian companies report under.
